Welcome to Life Chronicles. 🌍

Your guide to work, money and modern life in the UK.

We break down careers, the future of work and personal finance from changing jobs and getting promoted to making your money go further. Alongside that, we explore the psychology, relationships and life decisions that shape it all.
Expect clear insights, practical advice and unique perspectives you can actually use whether you're planning your next career move, building better habits or just making sense of a changing world.

New videos every week. Subscribe and take control of your life, unscripted. 🎯


#careers #futureofwork #careeradvice #personalfinance #uk
